scope: Corollary 1.2 (Ordinary log canonical pairs) of the manuscript “Minimal models and Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical Q-pairs” (preprints/Minimal-models-and-Mori-fibre-spaces-for-generalized-log-canonical-Q-pairs-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 036 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37e6d650c989c3fb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, B) be a projective log canonical Q-pair over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. There is a birational map ϕ : X --→ Y extracting no divisors, with BY = ϕ∗B, such that (Y, BY ) is log canonical and AX,B(E) ≤ AY,BY (E) for every prime divisor over the common function field, strictly for prime divisors on X contracted by ϕ. If KX + B is pseudo-effective, KY + BY is nef; otherwise Y admits a Mori fibre contraction with relative Picard number one and relatively ample −(KY + BY ).
